title.narrative: East African Community Project to combat terrorism and transnational organized crime in the region

description.narrative: The contribution hereby proposed by INTERPOL is part of the wider action to prevent and decrease regional and cross border security threats across the East African Community (EAC) region. The European Commission approved the Action Document that relates to this in November 2018.The overall programme is designed as a regional response to the various and growing security threats across the EAC region and builds on existing initiatives, with the objective to accompany and extend the development of key synergies and complementarities. The action will rely on an increased regional security integration and cooperation by facilitating the exchange of highly valuable related information, supported by joint regional instruments and technologically advanced tools.The broader programme will includes two specific objectives:Specific objective 1: Extended collaboration between EAC Law Enforcement Bodies (to be coordinated by the EAC Secretariat).Specific objective 2: Enhanced regional law enforcement bodies' abilities and capacities to jointly identify, prevent and track human and goods trafficking as well as movements of potential terrorists or wanted individuals (to be coordinated by INTERPOL).However, this particular action, managed by INTERPOL, concerns only specific objective 2.
